newsitem.title: USA: MCI to launch online games - USA Today.
newsitem.headline: MCI to launch online games - USA Today.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp is launching a national, on-line game service in the United States, USA Today said Monday.

The service is based on Wireplay, a service in Britain developed by British Telecommunications that lets personal computer users play popular computer games against other personal computer users, the paper said.

The report said MCI has not announced the service, but said British Telecommunication's chief of multimedia, Rupert Gavin, confirmed that MCI has licensed the technology and plans to introduce the service "within the next few months."
